references.text: Naphtali was born as the son of Jacob and Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant. This is the origin of the tribe of Naphtali as it is now counted.
Naphtali is mentioned as one of Bilhah's sons, confirming his place among the twelve tribes of Israel.
The sons of Naphtali are mentioned when Jacob's family went down to Egypt, showing the tribal genealogies.
Jacob's blessing over Naphtali, which gives prophetic insight into this tribe.
Ahira, son of Enan, was appointed as leader of the tribe of Naphtali at the census.
The result of the census of the tribe of Naphtali: 53,400 men fit for battle.
The tribe of Naphtali received its place in the camp on the north side of the tabernacle, together with Dan and Asher.
The second census of the tribe of Naphtali in the plains of Moab, showing the tribe's development over 40 years in the wilderness.
